Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to recognize that the task was effectively solved in Step 3. In Step 3, WebSurfer provided definitive coordinates (35.279026 N, 120.66376 W) and an address (733 Higuera Street) from authoritative sources (Wikipedia, Latitude.to). The Planner's "Updated Understanding" in Step 3 correctly identified these details but incorrectly concluded that "No solid confirmation yet of any other California Bubblegum Alley locations" and that "San Diego has been mentioned as a possibility but not verified." Despite having sufficient data to answer the primary question (location of Bubblegum Alley in CA), the Planner continued to issue redundant search instructions in Step 4 to "verify" information that was already confirmed and to search for "other" locations that the initial broad search had already implicitly ruled out (as no other results appeared). This represents a failure to consolidate results and terminate the task once the core objective was met, leading to unnecessary looping.
